method: standard preset at L41, table power; k bisected until BaselineDPR matches the real Current Game party ON BASIC GEAR (--baseline-gear all) in the same fight, same seed, same model. Basic gear on both sides, so k stands in for class skills only and items are measured on top of it.

fullGearFitForReference.note: What k would be if gear were folded into the skill layer (+69 damage at L41). Not used: it double-counts gear, and every item measured on top would read cheaper.

history.why: re-fit after the Protect redirect correction (engine.js): a protected hit is now re-checked and damaged against the protector, which lengthens the real party's basic-gear fights slightly and moved its DPR. Both values give +15 damage at L41; they differ by about 1 damage at L50.

readings: Offense is calibrated; defense is NOT fitted. On basic gear this fire-themed fight is a near-certain loss for both parties (real 75% defeat, archetypes 99.9%). Archetypes survive slightly worse: a 22-point smaller HP pool and no class defensive skills (Blanche's damage reduction, Keren's phantasms).
The fight ends sooner for archetypes (2.7 rounds) only because they are wiped sooner; the real party on basic gear drags to 5.0 rounds.
k is a single L41 anchor. At other levels the +round(k x L/10) damage and +floor(L/10) accuracy extrapolate linearly.
Damage is integer-rounded, so archetype DPR steps between 58.0 and 59.5 and cannot land exactly on 59.0; k is meaningful to about +-0.1.
